\textit{Population:} BASE. \textit{Unit:} artifact (shares) / finding (counts).
Per static analysis tool: the first row is the share of BASE DIRTY artifacts (F01 frozen rule) that are DIRTY only through this tool (denominator = F01 BASE DIRTY, checked); then its check ids with the most reported blocking findings on the composite BASE (at most 10 per tool, selected once there and reused for the blocks, checked): reported blocking findings and BASE artifacts with \textgreater{}= 1 such finding / BASE artifacts to which the tool applies (= the S02 BASE denominator, checked). Findings of different tools are never added.
POST-FREEZE (study\_analysis\_001.addendum\_1, DECLARED\_AFTER\_DRY\_RUN, declared 2026-10-17; descriptive, not part of the frozen methodology): X03 dirty\_composition - post-freeze descriptive; DIRTY means at least one finding the frozen tool configuration marks blocking, not a confirmed defect.
IC4: DIRTY means at least one finding the frozen tool configuration marks blocking (dominated by clang-tidy bugprone heuristics, see X03), not a confirmed defect; under the frozen rule findings of entries in analysis-gap states count (sensitivity X02).
\textit{Definitions} (methodology and addendum; full text in the JSON form of this table): BASE; X03 dirty\_composition; F01 static\_verdict\_three\_state.\par
